# Platform overview

## Integrations

I need you to slide kafka to the top edge. Before that, add a title named kafka please. Then okay so clone the title. Lets insert a white task in the lower right and then put a triangle in the center please.

Scale the rectangle to medium. Before that, can you sketch a rectangle inside the triangle and then okay so connect the task to the rectangle. Please slide the rectangle a third of the way to the left edge.

Okay so scale the rectangle to large. After that, i need you to scale the rectangle to large.

Could you copy the rectangle left of the task. Also, i need you to rename the triangle to ledger.

Please do not slide ledger above the white task and then link the white task to the triangle please. Also, lets place a service on the left side. Lets shrink the task.

Would you link the triangle to the task with a teal connector and then please copy the triangle. Encrypt the gateway. Can you remove it. Then could you connect ledger and the task with a connector, and now make it blue.

## User accounts

I want you to add a red ellipse. Scale ledger to medium. Then can you shift the task to the top edge, and lets slide the task a third of the way to the top edge. After that, scale the service to large please.

Now on the left side , create a thin task, but never drag the second task a third of the way to the left edge. Then i want you to slide the service 5 px left.

I want you to resize the service to small. Lets turn the ellipse teal.

Now draw a start in the top right. Now duplicate the start on the left side, and okay so join the first task to the second task, but i want you to bring the first task to front.

I want you to rename the task from section 1 peter. Also, now set the color of the first white task to teal and join the first teal task to the second thin task. I want you to make it yellow.

## Search

Would you connect peter and the ellipse with a thick connector, and would you copy the first task on the left side. I need you to slide the teal ellipse halfway to the right edge. After that, would you shift the ellipse 40 pixels left and i want you to rename the teal ellipse to beta.

I need you to drag beta to the left edge. After that, lets connect the service and the ellipse with a brown line, but okay so label the service signup. Could you slide the service to the right edge and then can you drag the service to the top edge.

Lets enlarge the teal ellipse, but please sketch a white circle called paul in the lower right. After that, delete it.

Could you rename beta to invoices. Then please never connect ledger to invoices. Lets push signup a quarter of the way to the left edge. Then could you slide signup down. I want you to attach signup to the ellipse with a large line.

## Billing

I need you to create a database called orders on the right side and then would you erase signup and then can you enlarge the database.

Link the database to invoices. After that, please erase invoices. After that, push the database halfway to the top edge please and then okay so delete it. Then now turn ledger purple.

I want you to put a star in the lower right, and please drag the star to the bottom edge. The marketing team prefers softer colours. Lets add five clients. Lets push the star in the top right and then i need you to align the clients horizontally.

Can you arrange the clients as a flow from left to right. Okay so join each client to the next one and then please sketch 4 tiny diamonds. Make the database feel more trustworthy. Okay so send the star to back.

Would you next to ledger , add a service. Please draw an ellipse called logger next to the service. Also, i need you to arrange all diamonds as a flow from top to bottom. Also, okay so paint ledger orange, but okay so join the star to logger with a line.

## Payment services

Okay so draw a solid actor and would you push the solid actor to the left edge. Okay so do not make the actor yellow.

I want you to place the actor inside the star. Attach the actor to the service with a solid connector, but please paint the service red.

I want you to send the service to back, but i need you to slide the star at the top. Can you rename the ellipse to shipping, and now rename the solid actor to storage. Then put a circle in the lower right.

Could you connect the star to the circle with a teal line, but i want you to place the star in the center. Okay so draw a huge note in the lower right.

I need you to link the ellipse to the note. After that, i want you to organize all diamonds in a circle. Would you arrange all diamonds in a column. Then now name the circle omega.

I want you to shift the circle to the right. Also, align all diamonds down please.

## Analytics

Would you add a hexagon labelled scheduler. After that, would you set the color of the hexagon to black.

Please never turn the hexagon orange. Can you organize all the diamonds as a flow from top to bottom. Can you call the circle archive. Could you sketch an api in the top left.

Can you paint the api from section 6 white, and lets link the api from the sixth section to the actor with an orange line. After that, lets distribute the clients evenly vertically. After that, i need you to align all clients horizontally. Also, now inside the star , create a database.

I want you to paint the database black. After that, put the black database in the center.

I want you to group these diamonds. Can you bring the circle to front. Then never remove all the clients, and could you label the black database omega, but okay so distribute the clients evenly vertically.

Connect the star and the hexagon with a thick line please and then paint the note pink, but i want you to send the note to back. I want you to create a textbox named search in the center. Then connect the clients in a chain.

## Back office

I need you to right of ledger , create a client, but make it bigger.

Please push the client from the seventh section to the left edge. Ask the architect whether this is correct. I want you to remove the diamonds.

Put archive on the right side please and then i want you to create a yellow report.

Now insert a tiny store next to the second textbox. Also, i want you to push the file to the top edge. Before that, could you right of storage , insert a file. After that, i need you to change the color of the second textbox to gray and then okay so connect the second textbox and the database with a large arrow.

On the left side , add a note please. Keep a backup of this somewhere safe. Could you place an actor in the top left.

Okay so push the second actor on the left side, but please move the note from section 5 150 pixels up and please space the clients from the fourth section 200 px apart.

## Shipping

Could you insert a title next to the actor from the seventh section. Also, now slide it in the top left.

Join the second api to the star please. Play a sound whenever a box appears. I need you to attach the second white api to the ellipse with a connector.

Send the second white api to back please. Send this to the whole team by email. Lets draw a pink cloud.

Sketch a triangle please. Print this diagram on a large poster. Please group the clients from the fourth section into a container called cart and i need you to connect the textbox from the sixth section to the star with an arrow.

Now make the textbox from the sixth section 60 % bigger. Imagine a river of data flowing through the system. I need you to group all clients from section 4 into a container called settings. Okay so make the cloud 100 percent bigger.

I need you to link the pink cloud to omega, and connect the pink cloud and the ellipse with a line please.

## Security

Okay so create an api next to the cloud. Connect the api from section 9 to the file with an arrow please, but never connect the api from the ninth section to the report with an arrow. It should look friendly to new customers. I need you to shrink search.

Can you space the clients from the fourth section 200 px apart. Lets make the note from the fifth section smaller.

Please insert a decision. Write a summary of the design for the board. Would you drag the decision to the top edge and then i want you to set the color of the circle to pink.

Could you put a thin caption inside the pink circle. Then would you call it auth. Also, would you distribute the clients from section 4 evenly horizontally.

Okay so connect shipping to the database. After that, okay so make the decision thin. Nobody remembers why the queue exists. I want you to send the decision to back. After that, can you join the decision to the first actor with a thick arrow. Then i want you to remove it.

# Warehouse system

## Search

Please insert 5 yellow squares. Animate the arrows with a gentle glow. I need you to arrange everything in a row. Sketch 3 boxes please.

I want you to attach all yellow squares one after the other, but okay so add a red file called supplier. Can you align all boxes to the right. Our cat walked across the keyboard here. Slide supplier in the lower right.

Okay so align all the clouds horizontally. Before that, i want you to add 6 clouds, but lets place a huge database in the top left.

Remove all boxes. Align the clouds vertically please.

Can you next to the red file , draw a server and then i want you to rename the file signup and now inside signup , draw a customer.

Would you copy the customer. Make it look like a subway map. Align the squares vertically please. After that, okay so set the color of the server to green.

Can you push the server to the left edge. Can you organize all the yellow squares in a grid.

## Billing

I want you to create 4 circles and then make signup large please. After that, i need you to space all the clouds 120 px apart, and now push the file to the bottom edge.

Can you link the file to the database. Also, could you move the server 75 px down. Also, please attach every cloud to the next one. After that, inside the server , sketch a white cloud please.

Would you copy the white cloud from section 2 at the bottom. Lets align all squares vertically.

Could you move the database to the bottom edge. After that, can you delete the database. I need you to organize the circles in a grid. Would you bring the red file to front. Now set the color of the file to brown.

Now arrange everything as a tree, and could you send the brown file to back, and can you insert a large note, and could you scale the note to medium.

Please paint the note blue. The marketing team prefers softer colours. Would you draw four tiny servers.

## Order flow

I need you to send signup to back, and now make the file large.

Can you call the brown file elena. Could you rename the file sessions, but make sessions huge. I want you to label it mark.

Shift the file a third of the way to the top edge please. Also, remove all circles please.

Please align the servers from the second section vertically, and would you align all the servers from section 2 horizontally and can you insert 3 solid queues.

Would you shift the note in the lower right. Then i need you to make the note 20 % smaller. Nobody remembers why the queue exists. Can you distribute all squares evenly vertically.

# Platform overview

## Data layer

Can you insert a thick note named redis. Then please scale the note to small, and would you resize the note to large. Would you scale the thick note to tiny.

Enlarge redis please. Then okay so place the thick note on the left side and then paint it red. Place a thin square inside the note please. Could you push the red note right of the square.

Could you turn the note yellow. After that, could you rename the note to peter, but lets attach the note to the square, but please drag peter halfway to the right edge. Set the color of the note to brown please.

Make the note 200 % bigger. Please organize everything in a circle. After that, would you remove this thin square. After that, insert a yellow user called final please. Also, can you make final smaller.

Would you connect the thick note and the user with a pink arrow and could you add a medium api named mark. Also, i need you to below the note , add a huge cache. The team reviews this flow every quarter. Scale the cache to huge.

## Reporting

Okay so insert a client. Change the color of the client to purple please, but i need you to move the client to the top edge. Could you push the client left of the cache.

Would you connect the client and the cache with a connector. I need you to left of the client , create a pink box. After that, please move the client a quarter of the way to the left edge. Then bring the purple client to front and could you drag the client 120 pixels up.

Now connect the client to the cache with a green arrow. A cloud hovers above the server, suggesting remote storage. I want you to rename the client to auth.

Lets slide auth to the left and i want you to grow the client. Everything here runs on Kubernetes. Dont attach the client to peter with a line. Then now rename the purple client to approval.

Could you put the client in the center and then now do not grow approval.

## Front end

Would you draw two orange diamonds. Could you connect peter to the cache and then copy the note, and now copy the box. I need you to align all diamonds horizontally.

I need you to move mark on the left side, but name the api sessions.

Okay so scale sessions to huge. After that, could you draw a caption and then lets scale the caption to tiny. Also, can you create a gateway.

Change the color of the gateway to teal please. Then please link the gateway to the caption, but i need you to drag the gateway a quarter of the way to the left edge. After that, now name the api frontend. Then i need you to push the api to the left edge.

Now make the api smaller. Also, wrap these diamonds please. Lets align all diamonds up and i want you to grow final, and i need you to connect the gateway to the caption with an arrow.

Lets drag the gateway up. Lets arrange all the diamonds in a grid. Highlight the risky parts in some way. Okay so organize the diamonds in a grid.

## Review

Can you sketch a title. Also, would you push the cache to the top edge. Highlight the risky parts in some way. Okay so create a solid diamond in the center.

Paint the second diamond yellow. This part was designed in a hurry. I want you to rename the title to signup.

Now shrink the title. Show the traffic in real time. Can you move the purple client on the left side.

Send the caption to back and join the caption to the api.

Create a black queue and rename the caption ledger. Also, please never paint it gray. Imagine a river of data flowing through the system. Can you attach the queue to ledger with a dotted line.

Now put the api 120 px left of the black queue, but i want you to scale the api to tiny.

Distribute the diamonds from the third section evenly horizontally. I want you to connect final to the caption with a gray connector. After that, i need you to space the diamonds from section 3 20 px apart.

## User accounts

I want you to move the caption to the top edge. Then i want you to connect the caption and the cache with a teal arrow and i need you to clone the caption inside the gateway, and could you connect frontend to the cache with a blue line. Sprinkle some icons around the edges. Now place a square inside the api.

Would you erase the orange diamonds from the third section. After that, okay so connect the cache to the title, and can you make the cache 50 % smaller and lets scale the api to large.

Would you rename the api to kafka. Can you bring the api to front, and okay so send kafka to back.

Could you create a small file named sessions right of kafka and then please make the diamond thick.

Shift the yellow diamond to the right edge please and then delete it please. I want you to change the color of sessions to purple. Then draw a server please, and please turn final black.

## Storage

Lets connect the user to the cache with a yellow arrow. Okay so tidy everything in a column.

# Platform overview

## Front end

If you create 2 green diamonds, i want you to attach every diamond to the next one.

Place a blue rectangle on the right side. After that, okay so add an user 80 px above the blue rectangle. Drag the user to the left edge. Then lets put a task below the user. Erase the task please.

Would you add a dotted service called ledger, but please make it large. Sprinkle some icons around the edges. I need you to set the color of the service to green.

Could you attach the rectangle to the green service with an arrow. After that, now add a star. Then can you make the rectangle twenty percent smaller. After that, lets rename the rectangle to profile.

Now shift profile to the left edge. This part was designed in a hurry. I want you to make the rectangle five % bigger. After that, i want you to insert 4 squares.

Could you put an orange task next to the star. Sprinkle some icons around the edges. Please grow the green service. After that, do not drag ledger a third of the way to the top edge.

## Messaging

Could you below the service , sketch a queue, but i need you to shift the user to the right edge. Lets group these diamonds as metrics. I want you to make ledger 5 % bigger.

Okay so put the rectangle inside the star. I need you to add a tiny server. After that, would you put the second server at the top.

Lets resize the server from the second section to huge. Please drag the second server a quarter of the way to the bottom edge. Now wrap these diamonds. I want you to on the right side , add a cloud. Our auditors asked for this view last year. I want you to align all the diamonds up.

Bring ledger to front please. After that, i need you to make the orange task dashed, and now slide the task to the top edge. Also, i want you to group the squares and insert 2 files.

Okay so move the task 25 pixels down. Also, okay so slide the user down. After that, can you connect every square to the next one and now paint ledger green.

## Data layer

If you create 6 captions, i need you to make the second server large, and i want you to label the service from section 1 settings. Print this diagram on a large poster. Lets put the task on the left side.

Please send the orange task to back. Lets make the user small. Please connect the user and the star with a blue line.

Would you rename the user to backend. Measure the latency of the payment path. Can you attach the star to backend, and please create a green report called refunds next to the star. After that, i want you to create a red gateway named epsilon in the top right and then i need you to set the color of the cloud to teal.

Lets join every square to the next one. Also, never set the color of the task to teal please and then join the cloud to the task. Put a black server inside the cloud please. Then would you group the captions.

## Monitoring

Can you drag the server from section 2 to the right. Okay so move the task next to the cloud. Highlight the risky parts in some way. Can you join the first service to the task with a solid connector. Could you turn settings yellow.

Could you send settings to back, but i want you to join each caption to the next one, but could you join all captions in a chain, but i need you to join the server from section 2 to the cloud.

Now connect the second server and the user with a line and would you align all files vertically, and sketch a diamond on the left side and please make the star 100 % smaller.

Now rename the queue to alpha. Also, can you wrap these files.

Could you connect the star and the third server with a connector. Make the database feel more trustworthy. Name the queue orders.

Would you align the diamonds from section 1 vertically. After that, tidy everything in a row please. Our cat walked across the keyboard here. Can you move the server from the second section on the right side.

## Storage

Next to the user from the first section , draw a customer and then left of the first user , draw a medium task. Also, okay so erase it.

Can you put the second diamond 40 px right of orders. After that, okay so insert a start and please link the task to backend with a line. Add a pink comment called admin.

Align the files to the right please. Measure the latency of the payment path. I want you to align the files up.

Would you place the red gateway right of backend. Slide the gateway 30 px left please.

Could you push the red gateway to the right edge. After that, dont delete the files please. Then place the cloud left of refunds please. Please create a tiny caption 40 px right of the cloud. Then can you copy the second customer next to the second caption.

Now turn the cloud purple. Draw a task next to the cloud. After that, lets make the second diamond solid.

## Order flow

Could you insert a white cache named postgres 15 px right of backend. The team reviews this flow every quarter. Okay so push postgres to the left edge.

I need you to link postgres to backend. Insert a pink caption.

Lets scale the third caption to huge, and would you slide the third caption halfway to the right edge. Keep a backup of this somewhere safe. Can you enlarge the diamond from the fourth section and then okay so put orders above the second diamond. After that, shift backend to the top edge.

Lets create a gray gateway. This part was designed in a hurry. Please organize all captions from section 3 in a circle. Also, please put a textbox 15 pixels below the third server. I need you to join the second textbox to the start.

I want you to connect the second textbox and admin with an arrow, and would you join the second textbox to the server from the second section, and i want you to shift the second textbox to the left edge. Can you rename the second textbox to auth. Play a sound whenever a box appears. I need you to drag auth to the right edge.

## Back office

On the right side , add a task please. Then push the third task halfway to the right edge please.

Now insert a solid diamond. Send this to the whole team by email. Please erase it, but okay so shift the second textbox up. Then never wrap all green diamonds from section 1. Also, can you drag the third pink caption to the left.

I need you to put a pink end next to the pink caption from the sixth section and then i need you to place the end on the right side. After that, i want you to link the end to backend with a dashed connector.

Please send the end to back and then can you connect the cloud and the end with a connector, and can you paint it green and okay so do not drag it in the top right. Also, would you enlarge the green cloud.

Could you turn the third caption purple. Also, lets place the caption from section 6 on the left side and then would you set the color of the third caption to blue, but could you make the third caption gray. Can you attach every square to the next.

## User accounts

Next to the server from section 3 , draw a dashed diamond please. Also, now make the diamond from section 4 blue.

Organize the files in a circle. Also, now never remove all diamonds from the first section.

Would you turn the third diamond blue. Also, now shift the second task halfway to the top edge.

Create a comment called partner 80 px below the second task, and please slide the third comment 10 pixels right of the task from the seventh section.

Would you wrap the files. Now push the second server halfway to the left edge. Also, lets place the server from section 2 next to partner and then please make the third server bigger.

Can you put the dashed diamond from the eighth section in the center. After that, now join the files in a chain.

# Shop architecture

## Reporting

Draw a cloud please. After that, lets draw a thin note.

Lets attach the note to the cloud with a teal arrow, but i want you to clone the cloud. After that, i want you to make it 40 % bigger. I need you to organize everything in a column.

I want you to slide the note ten px down and then could you sketch a purple square in the top right, but please draw a medium star. Make the square 20 percent bigger please. Also, now set the color of the square to white.

Can you remove the star and now send the thin note to back, and okay so join the square to the note with a line. After that, join the white square to the note please. Turn it red.

Okay so drag the note 100 pixels above the square and then could you slide the square to the right edge, and could you scale the note to large.

Please create a huge diamond called mark in the lower left. Place a box inside mark please. Please below the box , sketch a document and okay so move it in the center. Would you connect the square to the box.

## Monitoring

Please add a black triangle called nginx and then make the box solid please. Translate every label into French. I want you to scale the solid box to huge. Then slide it 50 px right of the note please. After that, i need you to delete that document.

Lets attach the note to nginx with a red arrow. After that, okay so rename the black triangle to pending.

Do not set the color of mark to red. Then scale the diamond to tiny please. Then lets copy the black triangle. Can you move mark a quarter of the way to the top edge.

Please push the diamond a third of the way to the bottom edge. After that, i need you to rename the diamond to postgres. I want you to rename the diamond to checkout.

Lets insert 6 customers and can you connect the thin note and the diamond with a gray connector.

I need you to drag the note 200 px above the box. I want you to group these customers as profile and can you insert a report called warehouse above the note and i need you to distribute all customers evenly vertically.

## Review

Can you insert 4 orange triangles. I need you to connect the square and the note with a teal line. Okay so align all the customers vertically and would you create 5 red reports. The team reviews this flow every quarter. Connect all the customers in a chain.

Would you push the square to the left. Also, please scale the report from section 2 to medium, and never move it in the lower left. Can you delete that note.

Shift the box up, and move the box to the left edge.

Would you connect the box and the square with a purple arrow. Lets draw a medium box. Then i want you to below the second box , draw a diamond and then okay so put a cache below the diamond from the third section.

Now paint the first box purple. Also, could you connect checkout and the first solid box with a gray arrow. Also, could you attach warehouse to checkout and would you link the cache to the diamond from section 1.

## Notifications

I need you to sketch a green decision named sara in the lower right, and please link the red reports from the third section in a chain. I need you to connect checkout and the box from the first section with a connector. Then now organize the customers as a flow from top to bottom. I need you to arrange all the customers in a circle.

Lets create a cache labelled maria. A cloud hovers above the server, suggesting remote storage. Please attach all the reports from the third section one after the other. I want you to align the reports from section 3 up.

Rename the second diamond to settings please. Would you insert a blue customer named accounts in the lower right, but i want you to turn accounts red. Give the user a happy face. I want you to make the report from the second section purple.

Shift the diamond from the first section 100 pixels left please and then can you draw a process labelled logger and then can you insert a title next to the third decision.

## Search

Lets add an actor named done. After that, do not scale done to small. Now clone accounts. Then put a server at the top please.

I need you to change the color of the server to blue. Play a sound whenever a box appears. Could you sketch an ellipse.

Delete done. Please add a rectangle inside the second diamond. After that, never connect every report from section 3 to the next one, and i need you to join the first diamond to the rectangle. Can you insert a solid start called storage in the lower left.

Okay so erase this start. Can you sketch a caption labelled refunds. Would you group the reports from the third section into a container called auth and send the rectangle to back please and can you make the first diamond solid.

Attach the ellipse to the first diamond please. Also, lets arrange the red reports from the third section in a column and could you push the second cache left of the diamond from the third section, but please place maria below settings.

## Analytics

Now shift logger above the start. Before that, would you add a start named inventory inside the cache from the fourth section. I need you to space all the red reports from the third section 120 px apart. Everything here runs on Kubernetes. I want you to enlarge the first purple report.

Lets move the diamond from the third section 60 pixels left. I need you to copy settings inside the box from the first section and send the caption to back please. Please clone the box from the third section.

Please duplicate the cache from section 4 below the title. Now in the top right , add a yellow server. Nobody remembers why the queue exists. Now never call the rectangle draft.

Lets link the rectangle to refunds with a pink line. After that, would you link sara to the server from section 6.

Please join sara to the rectangle with an arrow. Copy sara. I need you to rename refunds to sessions. After that, i want you to sketch a white queue in the lower right and then could you rename the queue to beta.

## Payment services

Would you sketch a title called shipping and could you make the first title 200 % smaller, and i want you to drag the first title to the bottom edge. Push the first title halfway to the right edge please.

Lets connect the first title and logger with a line. Make it look like a subway map. Could you make checkout purple.

Please remove checkout. It should look friendly to new customers. I need you to resize beta to tiny.

Would you add a pink client named reports_db. Also, turn it purple, but would you space the reports from the third section 15 px apart, and i want you to join the caption to the rectangle. Also, can you duplicate the caption next to the start.

I want you to paint the second server teal. Highlight the risky parts in some way. Could you align all reports from the third section to the right. Align the reports from the third section vertically. Could you shift the first title to the top edge, and would you make the second server 120 % smaller.

## Back office

Okay so sketch a gateway. I want you to name the queue postgres. After that, can you sketch a queue 200 px left of the first white queue. After that, make it small.

Now do not drag the second queue 60 pixels right and then can you put a database next to the start, and lets draw a star.

Please make logger thin, and can you drag logger to the right.

Now copy logger. Would you connect the square and the start with a line.

Would you join the square to the client with a dotted arrow. Then now attach the second queue to the gateway with an arrow. Then can you connect the queue from the eighth section to the star with a pink arrow.

Okay so space all the reports from the third section 40 px apart. Then shrink the server from section 6.

Push the database a quarter of the way to the top edge please. I need you to draw 6 green reports. Then arrange the reports from the third section in a grid please.

## Integrations

Lets connect inventory and the second queue with a connector, but i want you to shift shipping a third of the way to the top edge. Then please connect the star and the title from section 7 with a white connector. After that, can you drag the ellipse to the left. Also, lets group these reports from section 8 into a container called partner.

Drag the red square to the left edge. Also, now shift reports_db a third of the way to the top edge. Animate the arrows with a gentle glow. Could you place a start right of the client. Connect the ellipse and the queue from the eighth section with a connector please.

Push the ellipse to the top edge please. Also, could you push the rectangle to the left edge.

Align all reports from section 3 down please, and lets distribute all the reports from the third section evenly horizontally, and could you clone the first start below the gateway, but change the color of the queue from section 8 to black please. After that, i want you to shrink the queue from the eighth section.

# Order processing

## Payment services

Okay so draw a pink document named alpha and then would you drag the document a third of the way to the top edge. Then now resize the document to medium. Then can you enlarge alpha. Our auditors asked for this view last year. Okay so create an actor inside the document.

I want you to drag the actor to the right. Would you remove that actor, and lets move the document 100 pixels left and now set the color of the pink document to red.

Now make alpha small. Could you create a white caption. Now do not link the caption to alpha with a thin arrow. Add a dashed database left of the red document please.

Please do not make the document 200 percent smaller. Okay so inside the document , sketch an end. Users love how fast the checkout feels. Okay so add 6 large apis.

Okay so rename the red document to gamma and then would you link every api to the next. Then could you clone the database. Also, okay so clone the document 200 pixels left of the caption.

## Order flow

Add a task named auth in the top right please, and okay so never grow the task. Also, would you duplicate the task right of the end. Okay so sketch a black user right of the caption. Make the black user 5 percent bigger.

Would you make the black user huge, but put the user in the lower left please. Could you distribute the apis evenly vertically, and okay so move the white caption halfway to the bottom edge.

I want you to duplicate the end at the bottom. Move it inside the caption and then i need you to align all apis horizontally. Also, would you add four documents and then please turn the user black.

Could you arrange everything as a tree. Also, would you make the white caption small.

Please place an api inside the caption and then could you make the user small.

Can you group all apis from the first section. Lets distribute all the apis from the first section evenly horizontally. Now distribute the apis from section 1 evenly horizontally.

## Monitoring

I want you to sketch a yellow queue 50 pixels below the api from section 2. Now connect the second api and the user with a line and okay so push the second api 25 pixels down.

Would you send the white caption to back. After that, okay so space all apis from section 1 150 px apart. Then i want you to distribute all apis from section 1 evenly horizontally. Give the user a happy face. Could you arrange everything in a grid. Lets make the white caption 60 percent smaller.

Can you join the user to the queue. Now connect the user to the queue.

I want you to slide the user above the caption, and i want you to arrange the apis from the first section in a grid.

Now space all the apis from section 1 five px apart. After that, i need you to turn the caption green. Also, would you attach each api from the first section to the next. After that, okay so connect the queue and the api from the second section with a white connector, and set the color of the queue to pink.

## Storage

Connect the queue and the user with a connector please. Then i need you to connect the queue and the user with a connector. Enlarge the queue please. Play a sound whenever a box appears. I want you to organize the apis from the first section as a flow from left to right. Would you put the user inside the second api.

Would you connect every api from the first section to the next one. Also, i want you to create a black database in the lower left. Highlight the risky parts in some way. Lets create 2 clouds. Then i want you to shrink the caption and then would you place the caption above the queue.

Would you drag the green caption to the top edge. After that, i need you to call the caption delta, and i need you to attach all clouds in a chain.

Connect the second api and the user with an arrow please. Would you connect the queue and the second api with an arrow. Also, please do not rename the user login. I need you to slide the black user a quarter of the way to the left edge.

## Integrations

Now create a white customer named backend left of the first black user. Also, distribute all the clouds evenly horizontally and then can you distribute the clouds evenly vertically. Show the traffic in real time. Could you connect the customer from the fifth section to the first user with a tiny arrow.

Arrange all clouds in a grid please. Join all the clouds one after the other.

Would you send backend to back and then could you delete every api from section 1, and could you group all the clouds. A cloud hovers above the server, suggesting remote storage. Okay so group the clouds into a container called final.

Align the clouds up please and then would you make the pink queue 75 percent smaller. Now make the api 100 percent smaller.

Add a note named maria on the right side please. Send the caption to back please.

Okay so connect the queue to the api with a line, but please make the user from the second section large. After that, i need you to call the note scheduler and rename the note to billing please, but can you set the color of the note to pink.

## Billing

Make the note 30 % smaller. Give the user a happy face. I want you to add a yellow report. After that, lets make the caption 100 percent bigger and then now connect the queue and the black user from section 2 with a medium connector.

Add a triangle called elena and would you at the bottom , create a store, but group these clouds into a container called reports_db.

Arrange all clouds in a row please. Label the triangle logger please. Okay so place logger left of the note. Please make the triangle ten percent smaller. Okay so erase the clouds.

Now connect the api and the store with a gray connector. After that, i need you to bring the api to front. Would you add a customer.

Now drag the customer from section 5 a quarter of the way to the top edge. Would you rename the api postgres. Show the traffic in real time. Please add a note called refunds. Then i want you to clone the note from the fifth section in the lower left and then i want you to bring delta to front.

## Front end

Can you create a white title called accounts inside refunds. Then okay so make it brown. Then i want you to make it 30 % smaller, but lets erase the store.

Please dont delete the report. Rotate the whole picture slightly. I need you to call the queue cart.

I want you to drag cart to the top edge. Insert 5 ellipses please. Now slide the third customer 40 pixels up. Okay so copy the customer from section 6.

I want you to bring postgres to front and now slide the caption to the left edge, and could you drag delta to the right edge. Also, would you send the caption to back.

I need you to bring the green caption to front. Can you make it large. The team reviews this flow every quarter. I need you to connect the api to accounts. Would you turn it white.

I want you to rename postgres to ledger and can you place a box in the center. Also, place accounts on the left side.

## Search

Could you draw 5 apis. Also, could you shift refunds to the right edge. Can you connect refunds and the queue with a line.

Can you remove refunds, and okay so make the report fifty percent bigger. Okay so move backend to the left edge.

Attach the title to backend please. Also, i want you to connect accounts and the report with an arrow. Would you align all apis from section 8 vertically. Would you make the report 25 % smaller.

Would you turn the report green. Okay so make logger huge.

Never grow the triangle please. I want you to make it 100 % bigger. Then would you arrange the ellipses in a column. Also, lets send the caption to back and then okay so connect cart and logger with a large connector.

Now move the brown title down and then could you join the ellipses in a chain.

Join all the ellipses in a chain, and lets push the queue to the bottom edge. Lets clone the triangle inside backend. Can you shift the pink queue down.

## User accounts

I want you to place invoices inside the report. Before that, can you add a small cache named invoices.

I want you to move the report a quarter of the way to the bottom edge. Okay so connect each api from the eighth section to the next one. After that, would you push accounts 100 pixels right. Now place a triangle above the title.

Please next to the report , draw a caption, and would you add a service. Attach each ellipse to the next one and then please below the caption from section 9 , draw a small textbox, and would you space the apis from the eighth section 200 px apart.

Push delta to the right edge. Highlight the risky parts in some way. Can you arrange the ellipses in a grid.

I need you to send the queue to back. Also, create two green clients please, and attach the pink queue to the service from section 9 with a dotted line.

Would you push the queue a quarter of the way to the bottom edge and then would you place the queue left of the third service.
